::: {.lead-text}
I am an open-source developer in bioinformatics, based in Turku, Finland.
:::

I work at the University of Turku in the [Turku Data Science Group](https://datascience.utu.fi),
where I develop [R/Bioconductor tools](software.qmd) for microbiome data analysis.

My background is in bioinformatics, computing and business. I have master's degrees
in biotechnology, and in economics and business administration.

## Teaching

I like teaching. I am a certified [Carpentries](https://carpentries.org) instructor,
and I run workshops and courses on microbiome data analysis.
See the [list of presentations and workshops](presentations.qmd).

## Consulting

I offer consulting and training in bioinformatics, and data analytics for business.
We can start with a call in Finnish or English. See [services](services.qmd).

## Positions of trust

- **Chair of the Board, [The Finnish Society for Bioinformatics](https://bioinf.fi).**
  The national society for bioinformaticians in Finland. It runs networking events,
  training and Bioinformatics Day.
- **Member of the Community Advisory Board, [Bioconductor](https://bioconductor.org).**
  Bioconductor is an open-source project for bioinformatics software in R. The
  [Community Advisory Board](https://bioconductor.org/about/community-advisory-board/)
  represents the user and developer community in the project.
- **Coordinator, [CompLifeSci](https://biocityturku.fi/research-programs/complifesci/).**
  Computational and Molecular Methodologies for Life Sciences, a research programme of
  BioCity Turku that brings together computational and life science researchers in Turku.

## Event organisation

- Organising committee member of the European Bioconductor Conference since 2024
- Coordinated the European Bioconductor Conference 2026
- Coordinated several local and national events with 20–200 participants
